title: tk --help (cmd/tk/main.go printUsage) still advertises the deleted factory, cloud-run and herd command families
body: cmd/tk/main.go's hardcoded printUsage — the answer to `tk --help` and to every unknown command — still lists `factory` in its Commands line and carries full sections for `tk factory deploy|setup|status|dashboard`, `tk cloud run|stop|status|logs|trace` and `tk herd wait|reconcile|collect|cleanup/paint/notify`, every one of which now errors as an unknown command. The tyj finding covered cmd/tk/cmd/herd.go's Short/Long text only; this is the same defect one file over and can ride along with tyj's fix.
